stem.text: An increase in carbon dioxide in human blood shifts the oxyhaemoglobin dissociation curve to the right.
What is the explanation for this effect?

A.text: An increase in carbon dioxide concentration increases the breathing rate.

B.text: Carbon dioxide is more soluble than oxygen and displaces it.

C.text: Diffusion of carbon dioxide between the alveoli and the blood is more rapid.

D.text: Increasing the $\text{H}^{+}$ concentration decreases haemoglobin affinity for oxygen.
